title: Sneaker Captions Stay Safely Inside
tests: Tests caption accuracy, legibility and explicit safe-area placement throughout a finished vertical product ad.

faults.what: All three captions appear together in one stacked block at 1.9 seconds instead of appearing sequentially across the three shots; no captions are visible in the later supplied frames.

judge.summary: The white sneaker and exact wording are present, but all three captions are bundled into the opening rather than delivered in the requested sequence.

must_haves.item: One silent 9:16 video runs for approximately 15 seconds and contains three moving product shots.
must_haves.why: The supplied clip is identified as 15 seconds and the frames are 9:16, with different product views, but still frames cannot establish exactly three moving shots. The reported -91 dB peak is effectively silent, despite the conflicting speech transcription.

must_haves.item: The sneaker is consistently a white leather low-top with white laces, a white sole and no logo.
must_haves.why: The visible views consistently show a plain white leather-looking low-top with white laces and a white sole, with no visible logo.

must_haves.item: The captions read exactly “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.” and “Shop now”, in that order.
must_haves.why: All wording is exact, but the three captions appear simultaneously in the first sampled frame, not in the requested temporal sequence.

must_haves.item: Every visible caption's full bounds stay within the central 70% of frame width and central 60% of frame height, including during transitions.
must_haves.why: The visible text at 1.9 seconds fits within the specified safe area, although its background box extends farther sideways. Caption positions during transitions are not shown.

must_haves.item: Captions are legible against the footage and remain visible long enough to read.
must_haves.why: The white text is clearly legible on its dark translucent backing, but the samples do not establish how long the combined caption block remains visible.
